provenance_note: The model-fit table combines 395 complete source parameter records with 4,005 parameter samples derived from the source-linked scenario pool. Derived samples are not independent experimental observations.
validation_note: No ground-truth fault labels are available in the CECT table; accuracy, sensitivity, specificity and print-quality prediction metrics are not calculated.
skin_specificity: CECT is general extrusion-based bioprinting data, not a skin-only dataset.
